hero.title: Meet your Persona
hero.subtitle: An assistant that earns its keep in the first minute: it does one real thing for you, then keeps going.

features.title: Inbox triage
features.body: Read-only look at what actually needs you: who's waiting on a reply, what's a bill, what can wait.

features.title: Drafts you approve
features.body: It writes the reply in your voice and shows it to you. Nothing is ever sent without your yes.

features.title: Cancel subscriptions
features.body: Finds the renewal email, the cancellation terms and the deadline, then drafts the note.

features.title: Book appointments
features.body: Dentist, mechanic, haircut: it finds the confirmation emails and lines up the next step.

features.title: A real phone call
features.body: Two minutes on the phone gets everything set up. Hang up any time; it picks up in the chat.

features.title: Read-only and private
features.body: Gmail access is read-only, you can disconnect in one tap, and it never asks for more than the task needs.

wristband.name: Persona Band
wristband.tagline: Talk to your Persona with a press.
wristband.body: A screenless wristband for the moments your phone is in your pocket. Press to talk, feel a buzz when a reply or a reminder lands. No display, no notifications to manage, a battery that lasts about a week.
bullets: Press and hold to talk; let go to send
A short buzz when your Persona replies or a reminder is due
Works alongside the app; nothing extra to set up

products.name: Persona for iPhone
products.body: The full experience: calls, Messages, Gmail, reminders and everything your Persona learns about how you like things done.

products.name: Persona Band
products.body: The screenless wristband. Press to talk, buzz when something needs you.

products.name: Persona for teams
products.body: One Persona per person, shared inboxes and hand-offs for small teams.

experience.title: How the first five minutes go

steps.title: Text or call
steps.body: Say one thing you want off your plate, or take the two-minute call.

steps.title: One useful thing in the first minute
steps.body: A plan, a draft or three emails triaged before any setup talk.

steps.title: Connect Gmail only when it helps
steps.body: Read-only, one tap, and only because it gets that first task done.

steps.title: Your Persona gets a name
steps.body: Pick a name; it lands in your Contacts with its own card.

footer.privacy: Persona reads only what you connect, keeps drafts until you approve them, and never sends anything on its own.
